problem.title: Three questions many people ask at the end of the month

budget.title: Will my salary last the month?
budget.body: Without tracking expenses, the salary goes without knowing where.

inflation.title: My savings are worth less and less
inflation.body: Idle money loses purchasing power month after month.

card.title: I don't know what my card really costs
card.body: Installments, nominal rate (TNA) and total financial cost (CFT) look alike, and they are not.

solution.title: It is not a course: it is a wallet that teaches

route.body: "Get to know you" detects what you already know and proposes the path through seven levels, from the account to Invest. Every screen explains "Why it matters" and leads to the exact part of the guide.

"I already know this" to skip what you master
Just-in-time cards, even without a mission
Locked sections show what is missing
route.short: "Get to know you" detects what you already know and proposes a path of seven levels, from the account to investing.

practice.body: Missions are played in your own wallet: a loan leaves installments, paying the minimum adds interest and falling for a scam takes money away. Everything is reversed with actions inside the simulation, and every mistake ends in an explanation.
items: Nine kinds of challenges, with decision cases
Twelve tools with visible assumptions
Pockets and goals adjusted for inflation
Thirteen missions of 2 to 6 minutes

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. It is educational content: it teaches concepts and lets you practice with scenarios. It never recommends specific products, institutions or investments.
faq.q2: What does whoever offers Alcancía see about each person?
faq.a2: The organization, the school or the partner see learning progress: guides, challenges and completed levels. Never amounts, balances, habit answers or why a level is still locked.
faq.a3: Not yet. Today scenarios use example values labeled as such, with links to official sources. Real rates, UVA, inflation and exchange rate, with date and source, are planned; the money will stay fictitious and stock and CEDEAR prices will stay as examples.
faq.a4: The wallet companion: it warns before an avoidable mistake, explains after one and celebrates progress. It can be muted.
faq.a5: It is a portfolio prototype with fictitious data and no backend: everything you enter stays in your browser.
faq.a6: A fictitious wallet made to show Alcancía integrated in another app. It is a demo brand: it does not exist and does not imitate any real wallet.

profile.title: Investor profile test
profile.intro: Brokers ask for it before opening an account, to offer you products that fit your horizon and how much risk you tolerate. Taking it here shows you what it is like and what it is for.
profile.notAdvice: Educational content. Your result is not a recommendation and never becomes a portfolio: it only helps you understand the questions you will be asked.

meaning.conservative: You put not losing what you invest first, even if it grows less. Brokers usually show low-risk, high-liquidity instruments first.
meaning.moderate: You look for a balance: you accept some ups and downs so your money can grow in the medium term.
meaning.aggressive: You tolerate sharp drops in search of more long-term growth. It still makes sense to invest only money you will not need soon.

profile.why: Your result stays only in this browser. When you open your practice brokerage account in Invest, it is reused.

participant_product.title: What Hornero sees
items: Aggregated figures of groups of 5 people or more: how many people read guides, pass challenges and complete missions.

items: Your amounts: balance, movements, pockets, goals and what you enter in the tools.
Your answers about habits in "Conocerte".
Which sections of your wallet are locked or unlocked.

participant_product.title: Where your data stays
items: Your practice money and your answers about habits stay only in this browser.

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorHelp: Besides the password, every sign-in asks for a code. Never share the code.
security.offNote: Without two-step verification, the password alone gets into your account.
security.limitWhat: It is the most you can transfer or pay by QR in one day. If someone got into your account, they could not take more than that.
security.limitReset: The counter goes back to zero every day.
security.limitNone: No limit: choose one to protect your account.
security.limitTooLow: The limit has to be at least {{min}}, for example: 50,000.

help.chatty: Fuerte shows a dot when it has a new message.
help.important: Fuerte stays at hand, without new message dots.

receipts.title: Receipts and summary
receipts.empty: When you close your first month, its summary shows up here.
receipts.note: Summary of each closed month in the practice wallet. Only you see it.

reset.title: Start over
reset.body: Your wallet goes back to its starting state and missions in progress are cleared. Your learning progress is kept.
reset.confirmBody: The movements, pockets and settings you made in the practice wallet since the starting state are lost. This cannot be undone.

wallet.title: Hi, {{name}}. Welcome to Alcancía
wallet.body: It is a practice wallet: you get paid, pay, save and invest with fictitious money, and you learn as you go.

levels.title: The account opens by levels
levels.body: You start with the basics. Each section unlocks when you meet goals and challenges, and if you already know a topic, you can prove it with "I already know this" and move ahead.

privacy.title: Your data is yours
privacy.body: Your company sees your progress in the modules, never your amounts or your answers about habits. What you enter in the wallet stays in this browser.
privacy.body_education: Your institution sees your progress in the modules, never your amounts or your answers about habits. What you enter in the wallet stays in this browser.
privacy.body_product: Hornero sees only aggregate learning figures, never your personal progress, your amounts or your answers about habits. What you enter in the wallet stays in this browser.

account.title: Your practice account
account.body: We open your account with example data. You do not need to enter anything.
account.name: Name
account.noRealData: We never ask for a real ID, tax number, CBU, cards or passwords: everything is fictitious.

quiz.title: Get to know you · question {{n}}
quiz.habitHelp: There are no right answers: choose the one closest to what you do. This answer stays only in your browser.
quiz.knowledgeHelp: Choose the one you think is right. At the end we show the explanation of each one.
quiz.saved: If you leave, the question you are on is saved.

why.budget: We start with budgeting because it is the base of everything else: knowing how much comes in and how much goes out.
why.savings: We start with savings and emergencies: a fund for the unexpected protects you before any other decision.
why.debt: We start with debt and credit: paying off an expensive debt pays more than almost any savings.
why.inflation_rates: We start with inflation and rates: understanding how much your idle money loses helps you decide where to keep it.
why.goals: We start with goals and investing: with a clear goal, saving and investing have a purpose.

result.title: Your starting point
result.conclusion: Your strongest point is {{strong}}; we will focus first on {{first}}.
result.onlyKnowledge: The result comes only from the knowledge questions. Your answers about habits stay in this browser and nobody else sees them.
result.routeNote: Levels open in the same order for everyone; the path tells you where to focus. If a dimension came out advanced, you can take its mastery challenge.
result.nextSecurityBody: Turn on two-step verification and learn to protect your codes. It takes two minutes.
result.nextHomeBody: Continue in Home, with the active mission.

overview.title: Your account and your starting point
overview.taken: You took Get to know you on {{date}} ({{kind}}).
overview.repeatBody: Repeat it at the end of the program to see how far you came. Your starting result is kept.
overview.repeatAgain: You already repeated it once; if you do it again, your final result is replaced and the starting one is kept.

requests.intro: Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law 25.326 gives you the right to know what data there is about you, to correct it and to ask for it to be deleted. The answer comes within a deadline that depends on the request.
requests.right: What do you want to request?

detailsHelp.access: For example: I want to know what learning data my organization has about me.
detailsHelp.rectification: Which data is wrong and what it should say. Do not write amounts.
detailsHelp.deletion: Which data you want deleted. Your learning progress is lost and cannot be recovered.

requests.due: If you send it today, the answer arrives by {{date}}.
requests.demo: In the demo nobody answers requests: it shows how you would follow them. In a real program, they are answered by whoever your organization names as data controller.

access.label: Access

rectification.label: Correction

deletion.help: Ask for your data to be deleted. Answer within {{days}} business days.

page.title: Sources
page.intro: Where each piece of Alcancía's content comes from: the validated workshop content, the official sources with their verification date and the calculations checked by hand.
page.workshop: Workshop "Del aula al primer trabajo" (From the classroom to the first job), by Lourdes Pedaci
page.workshopBody: Workshop site with the sections on the payslip and personal finance, its calculators and the escape room "Tu primer sueldo" (Your first paycheck).
page.presentation: Presentation "Educación financiera: transformá tu relación con el dinero" (Financial education: transform your relationship with money), by Kevin Giampieri
page.presentationBody: Validated workshop material: money psychology, debt, management, investing and execution. Each guide lists the slides it uses.
page.extensions: What Alcancía adds to go deeper (capital markets, CEDEARs, wallets and fintech) is built on official sources and is pending review by Kevin Giampieri.
page.formulas: Project formulas, with cases calculated by hand
page.formulasBody: Every number in the guides, questions and tools comes from a documented formula, with its assumptions, simplifications and a test case calculated by hand.
page.sheetsBody: Brokers registered with the CNV and wallets and fintech are shown in information sheets, in alphabetical order and not as a recommendation, with a link to the official registry to check.
page.brokers: See the registered brokers in Invest
page.officialBody: Rules and data from the BCRA, the CNV, BYMA, Caja de Valores, argentina.gob.ar and INDEC. Each one with the date it was verified.
